meta.title: Is the light a soul trap? Should we reject it? - Hans Wilhelm

sentences.text: Hi, I am Hans Wilhelm. Many people ask, when I die, should I go into the light or not?
Does the light trap my soul in the cycle of reincarnation so that I can never evolve?
Let's explore that.
Physical death is the separation of the soul from its material body. There is nothing mysterious about it. It is a natural and organic process that most of us have experienced many times
before. I have various videos on this process. What we encounter shortly after death, however, largely depends on how we have lived our lives and also what strong beliefs we hold about
death and the afterlife.
At the moment of death most people will actually see a light, which Gabriel explains as follows.
During the process of death people who have lived consciously experience how a bridge of light forms in them, which conveys to them the desire to go across it.
Such a person did not waste away his life during his sojourn on earth, externalized and trapped on this side of life.
And spiritual beings help the soul, its guardian spirit and the higher developed souls of former friends and relatives.
They welcome the soul that is parting from matter and help it find its place in the beyond.
But this does not apply to everyone.

The moment of transition can be deeply confusing like in the case of a sudden accident And especially for those who never believed that life continues after death Some may not even accept that they are no longer in a physical body Gabriele explains it as follows
The soul, which is so strongly oriented to this life on earth, remains more or less connected with the physical body through energy currents even after it has left it.
It virtually clings to its physical house since it thinks that life is possible solely in a material body. Under certain circumstances, it fears what happens to the deceased body
regardless of whether it is carried to the grave or taken to the crematory. Please watch my video Life after Death.
So if a soul is strongly attached to aspects of their recent life, like possessions, places, status, pleasures, addictions or even other people, it could become an earthbound soul.
Gabriele explains, if someone is oriented only to the material and sees only the externalized life here on this earth as life, then his soul will want to continue to be active on
earth.
It will not even seek the possibility to go further and often will not listen to the teachings of the spirit beings.
Due to its freedom of will, it therefore remains in the earth sphere and remains an earth-bound soul until it sees reason and allows the guiding angel to lead it further on its way into purification.
But there is something we could call soul entrapment Yet that happens before we die It may occur when individuals have aligned themselves with destructive or dark forces
for personal gain, such as wealth, fame or power, during their lifetime.
In a manner of speaking, they entered into a pact with the devil.
After death, such souls will feel drawn into lower astral realms by the very forces or entities that served them during their earthly life and whom they may now find themselves
serving in return.
This all shows that not everyone will automatically perceive the light after disembodiment.
Our own personal spiritual evolution and our strong beliefs influence our experience at the moment of physical death.
So if somebody now comes and advocates never to go into the light, could it be that they They are used by the forces of darkness that seek to keep us confused and bound.
After all, our beliefs are powerful.
They can shape and create the very circumstances we fear, even after death.
If we expect trepidation, interference or feel the need to avoid the light, we may indeed create such experiences for ourselves.
What we hold in consciousness becomes the filter through which we experience reality here and beyond.

So the time to decide whether or not we will enter the light at the moment of our physical death is now today How we live our daily lives determines whether we are drawn by the light to the highest realms of purification or to the lower astral worlds
or even remain earthbound as wandering spirits. Let us activate the light within us now and create a deep communication with divinity and our guardian spirit who will receive us
once we leave our material body behind.
Over and over again Christ made it very clear that repeated reincarnation is not the will of the Divine.
If we live fully in accordance with the laws of life given to us in the Ten Commandments and in His Sermon on the Mount, there is no need for anyone to return to this earthly
existence.
As Gabriel says, our task as human beings is to bring our soul to full maturity so that After passing on, we may return as divine beings to the true origin of our being, to
the Spirit of God in the Kingdom of God, from where we once went forth.
There is much more that could be said on the subject of death and I made several videos about it.
I would like to mention two books that explore these questions in great depth.
One is called Where did I come from?
Where am I going?
And the other one is Living and Dying in order to keep living.
These books are written by Gabriele and you find links to these books beneath this video.
Please subscribe and let's meet again, because there is so much more I wish to share with you.
